"Hay varias notas que reportan el cierre del puente La Concordia por daños estructurales, pero todas parecen provenir de una misma fuente (Última Hora #), así que la repetición no constituye confirmación independiente. Los datos como las grietas en dos vigas, los # vehículos diarios y el desvío de # minutos dependen de esa única fuente, y el dato de que los daños se conocían desde hace un año proviene de un contratista anónimo. Por ahora no es posible confirmar que el puente se cerró específicamente por riesgo de colapso; conviene esperar comunicados oficiales de las autoridades de Villa Miranda.": "Several articles report the closure of the La Concordia bridge due to structural damage, but they all seem to come from the same source (Última Hora #), so the repetition does not constitute independent confirmation. Details such as the cracks in two beams, the # daily vehicles, and the # minute detour depend on that single source, and the claim that the damage had been known for a year comes from an anonymous contractor. For now, it is not possible to confirm that the bridge was closed specifically due to a risk of collapse; it is best to wait for official statements from the Villa Miranda authorities.",

Lo más prudente es verificarlo directamente en los canales oficiales de la Alcaldía.": "Information about the curfew in Puerto Celeste (from #:# p.m. to #:# a.m., for # days, with fines of up to # pesos for home burglaries) appears on several pages, but they all come from the same origin: a statement from the Puerto Celeste Mayor's Office. There are no independent sources to corroborate it, so I cannot confirm the details on my own. The most prudent course is to verify it directly through the Mayor's Office's official channels.",
